summary.zh: 生成并校验 JSON-LD，避免富媒体结果出错
summary.en: Generate and validate JSON-LD for rich results

description.zh: 为页面编写 schema.org 的 JSON-LD 标记，并按 Google 的必填属性逐项校验，减少富媒体搜索结果不生效的情况。适合新增结构化数据、或搜索结果展示异常时使用。
description.en: Writes schema.org JSON-LD and validates it against Google's required properties, catching gaps a hand-written block usually misses. Use it for new structured data or when rich results fail to appear.
